step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features an On-Premises environment, Region 1, and Region 2. On-Premises contains a Business Critical Service (BCS) on-prem node and AWS Outposts. Region 1 and Region 2 both host EC2 instances managed by InfoScale, connected to EBS and S3 storage tiers. Red lines show cross-environment replication from On-Premises to Region 1 and Region 2.
